label_definitions.00 Generic programmes and qualifications: Broad, non-specialised programmes developing basic, general or personal skills; covers a wide range of subjects with little or no field emphasis.
label_definitions.01 Education: Teacher training and education science; preparing educators and studying teaching/learning methods, curriculum, and educational systems.
label_definitions.02 Arts and humanities: Arts, design, music, performing arts, religion, history, philosophy, and languages/literature; focuses on cultural and creative expression and interpretation.
label_definitions.03 Social sciences, journalism and infor: Social and behavioural sciences, economics, politics, sociology, journalism, library and information sciences; studies society, people, and communication.
label_definitions.04 Business, administration and law: Business and management, accounting, finance, marketing, administration, and legal studies; focuses on organizations, commerce, and regulatory frameworks.
label_definitions.05 Natural sciences, mathematics and sta: Biology, chemistry, physics, earth sciences, mathematics, and statistics; studies natural phenomena, quantitative reasoning, and data methods.
label_definitions.06 Information and Communication Technol: Computer science, software, networks, databases, AI, and ICT applications; focuses on computing systems and digital technologies.
label_definitions.07 Engineering, manufacturing and constr: Engineering disciplines, industrial production, materials, architecture/ construction; applies science and technology to design, build, and manufacture.
label_definitions.08 Agriculture, forestry, fisheries and: Crop and animal production, forestry, fisheries, food-related agriculture, and veterinary medicine; manages biological resources and animal health.
label_definitions.09 Health and welfare: Medicine, nursing, dentistry, pharmacy, public health, and social care; promotes health, treatment, rehabilitation, and wellbeing.
label_definitions.10 Services: Personal, transport, security, environmental, and other service fields including hospitality and tourism; focuses on practical services for individuals and society.

courses.eng_desc: (A non-credit subject to the students' faculty code of 02, 04 and from 09 to 14, 16, 17, 18) Sets, the real number system, relations, functions and applications, introduction to linear programming, logic, measurement of interest, installment payment and income tax, descriptive statistics, index number, introduction to probability, basic concepts of inferential statistics, statistical packages.

(This course is for students who have already studied mathematics in high school and have gained not less than 16 credits or as demanded by their faculty.) Logical rules, methods of proofs for mathematical statements, arguments, mathematical induction, proofs of theorems of inequalities and absolute values, solving inequalities, functions, type of functions, applications of functions, curve sketching, partial fractions decomposition, solving simple systems of linear equations.

A basic fundamental theories and principles of soil and groundwater pollution including chemical biological and physical process, source of pollutants, toxic substances in soil and main components, bio-chemical reactions of toxic substances, transport of toxic substances in soil and transport of toxic substances from soil to groundwater, statistical evaluation, sampling techniques, prevention control and remediation of soil and groundwater pollutant.

A basic grounding in contemporary mass communication theories and models thatlead to effective planning and designing of communication materials used for social change andbehavior change theories and techniques for strategic change, application of knowledge throughan applied research project and integration of communication concepts with on-going projects.

A basic of quantum computer, qubits and quantum gates, quantum circuits, quantum Fourier transform and its applications, quantum algorithms, quantum optimization, error correction and error mitigation, quantum cryptography.

A brief history of Astronomy, light and astronomical instruments, the Solar System, stars, galaxies, the Universe.
